tagline.en_US: Host a live stream with an RTMP ingest endpoint and a public viewing page. The profile generates an administrator password and stream key, then passes both to Owncast at startup.

description.en_US: Owncast is a self-hosted, single-user live video streaming and chat server. It allows users to broadcast live video while retaining full control over content, moderation, and audience data. The platform provides a web-based viewing interface complete with an interactive chat and video player, and it is compatible with broadcasting software that supports RTMP.
